premises.text: International entrepreneurs face difficulties with cross-border payments due to territorial payment platforms.
premises.evidence_span: Platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Payoneer are all building cross-border payments that are territorial and not tailored to these needs.

premises.text: Integrating with multiple payment APIs is complex and time-consuming for entrepreneurs.
premises.evidence_span: the process of integrating with multiple payment APIs in different countries is incredibly complex.

premises.text: Many digital entrepreneurs lack the technical expertise to navigate payment integration.
premises.evidence_span: these entrepreneurs and creators often need a high degree of technical expertise to navigate this process effectively.

premises.text: Mainstack provides a unified API ecosystem that simplifies payment integration for non-technical users.
premises.evidence_span: Mainstack provides a unified and robust API ecosystem that abstracts the complexity of integrating with multiple payment platforms.

premises.text: Mainstack enables users to receive payments without writing code.
premises.evidence_span: enabling non-technical entrepreneurs and creators to get access to global payment options without writing any single line of code.

premises.text: Mainstack's platform allows users to select currencies and generate checkout links for transactions.
premises.evidence_span: she can now go to her dashboard on Mainstack to generate a checkout link to offer multiple global payment options via her own website.

premises.text: Mainstack has a growing user base and transaction volume.
premises.evidence_span: over 9,000 customers like Sandra now rely on Mainstack every single day.
